name: Zenith Burning Duel
name_jp: 究極バーニングデュエル
effects: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Zell (Fire)] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Zell (Fire)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Zell (Fire)
description.text: Increases [Fire Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Zell (Fire) after using a Monk ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Meteor Barret+
description.text: Six single ranged attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Final Punch+
description.text: Four single attacks (1.10 each), grants [Monk Quick Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Zell (Fire)
description.text: Grants [Weakness +30% Boost 3] to the user if 0-2 Monk allies are alive, grants [Weakness +30% Boost 3] to all allies if 3 Monk allies are alive, grants [Weakness +30% Boost 3] and one single attack (3.36) capped at 99999 if 4+ Monk allies are alive

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
